known_limitations: Answer faithfulness and answer relevance are not scored numerically in this harness — doing so correctly requires either human annotation or a separate LLM-as-judge pipeline, which is out of scope for this MVP. Raw answers are captured so a human reviewer can score them.
Citation correctness is checked structurally (citations are present and reference real source titles from the retrieval step) but not verified sentence-by-sentence against source text.
Token usage and estimated cost per query are only available when OPENAI_API_KEY is configured; see ai_engine/llm_client.py's returned `usage` dict on live runs.
This is a small, 4-question reproducible dataset for pipeline verification, not a comprehensive benchmark.
